subject: Shorthand
examFormat: Two passages are dictated at 80 words per minute with a 2-minute interval; the syllabic intensity is 1.35-1.40 and each passage lasts 3 minutes. After the last passage 5 minutes are allowed for reading through shorthand notes, then candidates transcribe on the typewriter (English and shorthand dictionaries allowed). The examination lasts 1 hour 13 minutes: 6 minutes dictation, 7 minutes intervals and 1 hour transcription. A 2-minute preliminary passage is dictated first and is not transcribed.
excluded: Notes on the examination (candidates provide own typewriters and notebooks, Council-supplied typing paper, no carbon copies, reader's access to passages, invigilation) and the reading list, which are administrative and not syllabus content.

topics.name: Business Matters
objectives: Take down in shorthand a dictated business passage (letters, memoranda, reports and related topics) at 80 words per minute
Transcribe the shorthand notes on the typewriter
topics.content: One of the passages for dictation shall be business in nature, e.g. letters, memoranda, reports and any other related topics.

topics.name: Literary Matters
objectives: Take down in shorthand a dictated literary passage within the candidate's experience at 80 words per minute
Transcribe the shorthand notes on the typewriter
topics.content: The other passage shall be literary and within the experience of the candidates. It shall not be technical or controversial.
